name: classify-tickets
description: Classification: label support tickets with category and sentiment as strict JSON

messages.content:
Classify each support ticket below. For each, produce an object {id, category, sentiment} where category is one of BILLING, BUG, FEATURE_REQUEST, ACCOUNT, OTHER and sentiment is one of POSITIVE, NEUTRAL, NEGATIVE.

Return a JSON object with a "results" array holding these objects in the same order.

Tickets:

[T-101] I was charged twice this month, please refund one of the payments.
[T-102] The export button does nothing when I click it on Safari.
[T-103] Loving the new dashboard! Would be great to have a dark mode too.
[T-104] How do I change the email address on my account?
[T-105] Your service has been down for two hours and I'm losing customers. Unacceptable.
[T-106] What are your office hours over the holidays?
